_meta.description: Compose batch of two crosstab slots (control + variant treatment arms of the experiment cohort) over region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_CHISQ_VS_REF scalar compose overlay that runs a whole-matrix chi-square test of independence between the target matrix and the reference matrix (treated as two contingency tables, target observed vs reference-scaled-to-target-N expected). Reuses the chiSquareSurvival helper backing TEST_CHISQ + the MATRIX-host CHISQ family so the overlay and the row-test surface emit identical p-values for the same contingency. Each layer carries an OverlaySummary{Statistic, PValue, Parameters{df}} scalar. Sibling shape to the per-cell OVERLAY_PROP_Z_CELL (13_compose_prop_z_cell.json) — both run an inferential test against the reference slot, but CHISQ_VS_REF surfaces ONE scalar per target matrix instead of one p-value per cell. Inherently buffered (inferential family).
_meta.name: compose-chisq-vs-ref
